tagline.en: Apache-2.0 6B vision-language-action policy on a Qwen3-VL MoE backbone, for robot control.
tagline.zh: Apache-2.0 许可、基于 Qwen3-VL MoE 骨干的 6B 视觉-语言-动作策略,用于机器人控制。

en: LingBot-VLA 2.0 is the next-generation LingBot vision-language-action policy for robot control, built on a Qwen3-VL Mixture-of-Experts backbone. It integrates the official policy, batched inference, feature transforms, robot mappings, and normalization directly for action prediction.

The runtime preserves official batched observation inference and Qwen3-VL image_grid_thw handling, works with a 55-dimensional internal representation and a denoising step, and offers optional torch.compile paths. Perception teachers used only during training are excluded — the model consumes their distilled representations from the trained weights. The public 6B checkpoint uses a bundled official-derived inference config, and robot-specific downstream checkpoints can override it with their own config file.
In WorldFoundry you stage the 6B checkpoint (published under Apache-2.0 on Hugging Face) and its Qwen3-VL processor assets, supply observations, and the model returns an action prediction.
zh: LingBot-VLA 2.0 是新一代 LingBot 视觉-语言-动作策略,用于机器人控制,构建在 Qwen3-VL 混合专家(MoE)骨干之上。它直接集成了官方策略、批量推理、特征变换、机器人映射与归一化,用于动作预测。
运行时保留了官方的批量观测推理与 Qwen3-VL 的 image_grid_thw 处理,使用一个 55 维内部表示与一个去噪步骤,并提供可选的 torch.compile 路径。仅用于训练的感知教师被排除在外——模型从训练好的权重中消费它们蒸馏出的表示。公开的 6B checkpoint 采用自带的官方衍生推理配置,机器人专用的下游 checkpoint 可用各自的配置文件覆盖它。
在 WorldFoundry 中,你备好 6B checkpoint(以 Apache-2.0 发布于 Hugging Face)及其 Qwen3-VL 处理器素材,提供观测,模型便返回动作预测。

whenToUse.en: Use it when you want the latest LingBot VLA policy — a Qwen3-VL MoE-based model with batched inference — for robot action prediction and control.
whenToUse.zh: 当你想要最新的 LingBot VLA 策略——一个基于 Qwen3-VL MoE、支持批量推理的模型——用于机器人动作预测与控制时,选它。

notFor.en: It outputs robot actions, not media. The 6B checkpoint and its Qwen3-VL processor assets download separately, so plan for the download and disk space.
notFor.zh: 它输出机器人动作而非媒体内容。6B checkpoint 及其 Qwen3-VL 处理器素材需单独下载,请预留下载时间与磁盘空间。
